notes.title: First public playtest at ABRING 2025!
notes.notes:
[p][b]What a weekend![/b][/p][p]Showing [i]Plush Time[/i] at [b]ABRING 2025[/b] was an incredible ride — two packed days full of laughter, chaos, and cake fights.
As a solo dev, it meant the world to see the booth constantly buzzing, with players lining up, excited to dive into the game.[/p][p]One unexpected star of the show? [b]Sugar Rush[/b] — the minigame where players brawl over a cake. It was a fan favorite, and hearing people cheer, laugh, and come back for rematches gave me a clear signal: I’ll definitely be cooking up more [b]combat-focused minigames[/b] soon.[/p][p]Leading up to the event was a bit of a sprint — a good kind of crunch — as I added tons of new content just in time. The build featured [b]9 fully playable minigames[/b] and [b]5 unique rooms[/b], and seeing people interact with all the new features for the first time made every sleepless night worth it.[/p][p]Best of all? I walked away with a notebook full of insightful feedback and brilliant suggestions from both players and fellow developers.[/p][p]The project is inching closer to its first public milestone: a [b]Steam demo[/b] featuring [b]15 minigames[/b], [b]6 rooms[/b], [b]2 game modes[/b], and [b]1 full board[/b] to explore.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who stopped by, shared kind words, and played along. I can’t wait to share what’s next.[/p][p]
[b]Wishlist [i]Plush Time[/i] on Steam to follow the journey![/b][/p][p]🎂🧸🕹️[/p]
